what: T1 P0.1: one content verdict per member per answer, guarded by a cheap tree stamp (audit 第六刀)
tree: target/scale/w50 = 20 members x 2,503 .rs files = 50,060 files, records published per member (`verify`, pipeline only); target/scale/t3 = 1 member x 2,504 files
protocol: one fresh process per run: `target/debug/nichlink-mcp --call search --query <q> --root target/scale/<tree>`, wall clock by bash TIMEFORMAT=%R; three runs per arm, arms INTERLEAVED in one session (baseline, cut6, baseline, cut6, ...) so load and page cache hit both arms

arms.baseline: c29ffa2 (plus the docs commit 7c1eecf): `build_output_is_current` called directly by three readers; the hash is paid twice per member (40 for 20 members)
arms.cut6: one paid entry point `freshness::verdict`, `Verified` carries a stamp (file count + newest mtime of `src/**/*.rs`, read from directory entries), `remembered()` only reuses while the stamp still matches, and the stamp walk is taken once per member per answer (`begin_answer` at `set_policy` and at `roots_with_freshness`)
arms.cut6_three_walks: the same cut-6 code BEFORE the per-answer stamp memo: the stamp guard was walked by all three readers (60 walks for 20 members)

rows.verdict: indistinguishable: one member, so the duplicate payment this cut removes is worth ~0.2 s there, below the noise

mechanism_counts.protocol: instrumented build (eprintln in `build_output_is_current` and in `tree_stamp`), one `--call search --query child000001 --root target/scale/w50` run, counters read from stderr

baseline_before_this_round.note: 20 members x 2 readers, measured in the fifth cut

mechanism_counts.reading: one verdict per member (the duplicate payment is gone) and one stamp walk per member (the three readers share it inside one answer)

box_note: this session's box is about 1.4x slower than the one that measured the fifth cut: the SAME baseline binary measured 11.28 s here against 7.90 s there, so absolute seconds are NOT comparable across sessions. Ratios inside one session are, and the baseline/cut6 pair above was measured interleaved.
estimation_rule: the numbers above are all MEASURED. No figure in the checklist's P0 table is an estimate; where an estimate was written down it is labelled as one.
open: T1 acceptance p95 <= 1 s is NOT met (7.5 s on this box, ~5.3 s scaled to the quieter box)
